Name: Normalise without collapsing
Decision / rule: Map to canonical concept candidates while preserving original text, event type, source and time
Safety invariant: No source assertion is destroyed by normalisation

Name: Partition by semantic event
Decision / rule: Separate diagnosis vs symptom, order vs actual use, dispense vs administration, planned vs performed procedure
Safety invariant: Different clinical event types are never reconciled as if identical

Name: Assess freshness
Safety invariant: Stale data may inform but cannot silently satisfy a current-data requirement

Name: Assess source fitness
Decision / rule: Apply source-authority matrix rather than universal hierarchy
Safety invariant: Patient report is not globally weaker than EMR data

Name: Detect relationship
Safety invariant: Semantic equivalence must be established before declaring conflict

Name: Assess materiality
Decision / rule: Classify LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL based on possible perioperative consequence
Safety invariant: Potentially serious allergy, airway, anticoagulant, identity or procedure conflicts cannot auto-resolve

Name: Attempt safe deterministic resolution
Decision / rule: Use version/time/event semantics and explicit governed rules
Output: Resolved composite fact or unresolved conflict
Safety invariant: LLM preference alone is never a resolution rule

Name: Conversational clarification
Input: Unresolved conflict where patient can help
Decision / rule: Ask focused non-leading question, exposing only necessary discrepancy
Safety invariant: Do not pressure patient into false precision

Name: Retrieve collateral
Input: Conflict remains and external source likely to resolve
Output: New source assertion or open task
Safety invariant: Missing collateral does not become a negative

Name: Human verification
Input: High/critical or clinically consequential unresolved conflict
Safety invariant: AI cannot close high-risk unresolved conflict

Name: Construct current clinical state
Decision / rule: Select/compose current working fact with component-level provenance and verification state
Output: Canonical Fact + supporting Assertions + Conflict objects
Safety invariant: Working fact never erases dissenting material assertion

Name: FHIR projection
Decision / rule: Map each assertion/fact/issue/action to appropriate resource(s) and Provenance
Safety invariant: FHIR projection cannot increase certainty beyond canonical state
